cycles.title: Cycle count
cycles.description: How many energise/de-energise cycles to run. Endurance tests raise this.

on_value.title: Coil ON value
on_value.description: Value written to relay_coil to energise the relay.

off_value.title: Coil OFF value
off_value.description: Value written to relay_coil to release the relay.

settle_s.title: Settle time (s)
settle_s.description: Dwell after each coil change before reading feedback. From the relay's operate/release time in its datasheet.

fb_min.title: Feedback — min limit
fb_min.description: Lowest acceptable relay_feedback when closed. Below it the contact did not make.

fb_max.title: Feedback — max limit
fb_max.description: Highest acceptable relay_feedback when closed. Above it may indicate a welded/stuck contact.
